description: Incident resolve on a split gateway's START execution-listener chain (#1406 finding 7, the #1402 gateway shape). `amount = 10` would route `g` to `f`; listener `l0` writes `amount = 500`, then listener `=nextType` fails. Resolving restarts the chain at listener 0 (Zeebe re-creates `l0`'s job); the route is taken once the chain drains.
